fcble XIX, furnisned by Deputy Commissioners from the records of the Census of 1868. The figures for 1875 are taken from the corrected figures published in the Supplement to Punjab Gatette^
airy 1877, pages 57/f, and in some cases differ largely from those given in the Provincial Civil List, which have been commonly quoted as correct.
